item.name: INT-015 Step 3 Staff sees a possible match

exec: pm.test('A match exists for the two reports', function () { var m = pm.response.json().matches || []; var ids = [pm.collectionVariables.get('LOST_REPORT_ID'), pm.collectionVariables.get('FOUND_REPORT_ID')]; var hit = m.filter(function (x) { var a = (x.reportA && x.reportA._id) || x.reportA; var b = (x.reportB && x.reportB._id) || x.reportB; return ids.indexOf(String(a)) > -1 && ids.indexOf(String(b)) > -1; }); pm.expect(hit.length).to.be.above(0); });
